state_convention.bit_order: LSB-first: integer bit 4*j+r is row r, column j
state_convention.round_constant_injection: bit j of RC_r is XORed into state bit 4*j for j=0,...,7 before the S-box layer

characteristic.sequence_semantics: differences[2*r] is the S-box input difference A_r; differences[2*r+1] is the S-box output difference B_r; differences[2*r+2]=P(B_r)

signed_qdt_definition: D[(v,b),(u,a)] = (1/16) * sum over x satisfying S(x xor a)=S(x) xor b of (-1)^(<u,x> xor <v,S(x)>), with GF(2) inner products

global_mask_trail.variables: U_0,...,U_10 before S-boxes and V_0,...,V_9 after S-boxes
global_mask_trail.coefficient: product of the 640 local signed QDT coefficients
global_mask_trail.constant_phase: multiply round r by (-1)^<U_r,C_r>, where C_r contains RC_r[j] at state bit 4*j
global_mask_trail.leading_definition: a leading trail has absolute coefficient equal to the all-zero-mask trail coefficient

strict_zero_criterion: If any collection of leading mask trails for a fixed characteristic has signed coefficients summing to zero, XOR translation by those masks partitions all remaining mask trails into equally cancelling classes; therefore the complete fixed-constant characteristic probability is exactly zero.
